findings.before: A clean Git status can hide assume-unchanged runtime modifications; standalone native and source-pair labels were not tied to the named Git blobs.
findings.repair: Compare actual source bytes with the pinned Git blob inventory, allowing only recorded LF/CRLF checkout equivalence. Retain full raw snapshots and checkout identities.
findings.reproduction: Source-pair unit test creates a temporary Git repository and hidden runtime modification.

findings.before: Missing receipt fields compared equal; a successful no-op response could pass response-only compatibility assertions.
findings.repair: Require response schema, execution identity, completion feedback, an actually created actor/graph mystery, owned character, and a matching completed durable mutation guard; retain raw replies and full database snapshots.
findings.reproduction: No-op response and absent/mismatched persisted receipt negative controls.

findings.before: An output ancestor junction could place raw evidence inside a source checkout.
findings.repair: Resolve the existing parent and newly created output paths before accepting containment.
findings.reproduction: Temporary external alias into checkout is refused.

findings.before: Early connection failures and interrupted/hung child processes could escape final evidence recording.
findings.repair: Write reservation, phases, logs and request records incrementally; signal-triggered failure handling and bounded graceful/TERM/KILL cleanup retain a nonpassing result.
findings.reproduction: Deliberate database refusal, signal during stalled startup, and stubborn child controls.

findings.before: Early source-pair harness used an invalid Director mode and then required byte-identical refreshed projections and replay telemetry.
findings.repair: Use DIRECTOR_DISABLED; compare durable command results and all game state. Only bootstrap observation time and explicitly validated replay diagnostic rows are excluded from the comparison; raw state remains retained.
findings.reproduction: Private retained source-pair attempts 1-3 fail; attempt4 passed the scoped pre-review comparison. Reviewed controls and final integrated native rerun are separately required.
